    *   Goal: Find the number of male contestants.
tail:
es that "the rest are male." This means the remaining contestants are male.

$$ \text{Number of Males} = \text{Total Contestants} - \text{Number of Females} $$
$$ \text{Number of Males} = 18 - 6 $$
$$ \text{Number of Males} = 12 $$

$$ \text{Number of Males} = \left(1 - \frac{1}{3}\right) \times 18 $$
$$ \text{Number of Males} = \frac{2}{3} \times 18 $$
$$ \text{Number of Males} = 12 $$

There are 12 male contestants.
